note: Photo mode (B2 P1, approved October 30, 2026): P or Photo on the ground bar opens it. World time pauses while you frame (creatures keep breathing) and the camera never startles anything. camera: the free camera. Below (on foot) it stays within belowRadiusM of the walker; above it may go anywhere over the island (the orbit camera's worldRadius plus targetMargin) up to maxHeightM. It never comes lower than minHeightM over the ground or the water. moveMps: W A S D and Q / E (down, up) at this pace, runK with Shift; lookDegPerPx: a drag turns the view; wheelM: one wheel notch moves this far forward or back; halfLifeS: how softly the camera follows. dof: physical depth of field on the linear HDR image, before exposure, bloom and the tonemap. A thin lens on a sensorHeightMm sensor (full frame), its focal length from the field of view; fStops: the aperture slider's stops, startStop its first place; maxRadiusPxAt1440 caps the blur circle's radius and stepPxAt1440 spaces the samples (both scaled with the image height); focusHalfLifeS: how quickly focus follows a click. filters: painted at the palette end of the tonemap, after the LUT, so the light stays physical. soft lightens the picture toward the bloom chain's soft copy (glow, a diffusion filter's look), lifts the shadows toward the paper, eases the saturation and fades the edges toward the paper (vignette); pencil draws the scene as graphite hatching on paper, its strokes from the image's lightness and the soft outline, with a little of the palette's colour kept (tint). frame: aspect choices (screen keeps the window's), the thirds guide, and the paper margin (a share of the shorter side) in paperHex. light: the hour dial (only the look moves; the world stays paused) and exposure in stops. export: the PNG is drawn offscreen at scale times the window, no larger than maxSidePx on its longer side; fileStem names the file.

words.help: W A S D to move, Q and E down and up, drag to look, wheel to step, click to focus
